scope: Corrected controller+named local driver bounds, composed COM and torso-contact randomized simulation. No hardware claim or automatic promotion.

metrics.scope: simulation only; measured velocities are simulator observations, not hardware speed

driver_target_contract.order: raw action retained; affine target; controller clamp; driver clamp; encoder-bias correction; actuator latency
driver_target_contract.scope: Position-command limits under active PD control; no claim about installed robot limits, measured torque or physical validation

locomotion_contact_contract.scope: Torso contacts terrain and nonadjacent active knee/foot spheres; no lower-leg hulls added. Original masses, sphere geometry and sphere collision properties retained.

domain_randomization.sampling: startup parameters are sampled once per world, not re-sampled each reset
domain_randomization.scope: initialized simulator fields; does not establish policy robustness or hardware transfer

collision_model.scope: actual compiled collision masks; disabled torso geometry can be measured diagnostically but contributes no contact response

provenance.randomized_flag_semantics: selects training task configuration; play configuration already retains startup physics randomization and observation noise
